solution:
**Given:**

cotθ = 3/4

**Formula Used:**

cotθ = adjacent ÷ opposite

theta; = opposite ÷ hypotenuse

cosθ = adjacent ÷ hypotenuse

**Calculation:**

⇒ adjacent = 3, opposite = 4

⇒ hypotenuse = √(3² + 4²) = 5

⇒ sinθ = 4 ÷ 5

⇒ cosθ = 3 ÷ 5

⇒ (1 + sinθ) ÷ cosθ = (1 + 4/5) ÷ (3/5) = (9/5) × (5/3) = 3

⇒ (1 - sinθ) ÷ cosθ = (1 - 4/5) ÷ (3/5) = (1/5) × (5/3) = 1/3

⇒ Total = 3 + 1/3

⇒ Total = 10/3

**∴ The correct answer is 10/3.**
